::: {.callout-note}
## Phase 1 is active; execution is disabled

Phase 0.75 is complete. Phase 1 is open for sequential artifact-execution work, but
paid compute, prototype execution, benchmark execution, training, and cloud mutation
all remain disabled. `EXP-0001` is planned and not run. `PLAN-EXP0001-SMOKE` still
requires one exact current-turn human authorization; its USD 4.00 proposal grants no
authority and is not authorization.
:::

GIC Lab studies a narrower and more falsifiable question than “can we build a GIC agent?”:

> Which proposed mechanisms are necessary, sufficient, learnable, and measurably better than matched external orchestration?

The program begins with the authors' released SiRA and SR²AM references, then isolates one mechanism at a time under declared resource budgets. Negative and inconclusive evidence is a valid outcome.

## Phase 1 boundary

- Execute work packages sequentially and only under their exact current-turn human
  authorization; analysis tasks do not inherit execution authority.
- Keep the first smoke to one matched SiRA reactive/simulative pair and prohibit
  scientific interpretation.
- Preserve raw evidence, version/hash identity, budgets, attempts, and verified cleanup.
- Record the fixed SiRA mode as `experiment_assignment`, never learned regulation.
- Treat any planned/deferred RQ-H2K trace-sufficiency output as infrastructure evidence
  only; it adds no experiment, condition, training path, learned kernel, or later phase.
- Keep the pilot, SR²AM cloud runs, benchmark execution, and training unauthorized.

See [project status](generated/status.qmd), the [claim map](research/claims.qmd), and the generated [experiment registry](generated/experiments.qmd).
